title: observability: refine token-kv cost/latency dashboards and alert tuning
author: Michael Chen
description: Context: recurring noisy alerts from token-level KV cache cost/latency panels caused pager fatigue and obscured real regressions. This PR refines dashboards, improves aggregation queries, and tones down alert thresholds to reduce false positives while preserving sensitivity to real regressions. Changes include: add per-model and per-route token cost breakdown panels; switch from mean to P99 and include P50/P90 for context; add cache-hit bucketed histograms and KV cache latency heatmaps; revise alerting rules to use adaptive baselines and increase evaluation window from 5m to 15m for cost/latency signals; add an ops runbook section in docs for investigating token-level regressions. Implementation notes: updated Grafana dashboard JSON, tightened telemetry aggregation in telemetry/aggregation.go to expose token_kv_cost and token_kv_latency metrics, introduced new PromQL queries (scripts/grafana/queries/token_cost.sql) with cardinality safeguards, and adjusted alert config (telemetry/alerting/token_kv_alerts.yaml) with new mute rules for low-traffic models. Checklist: - [x] Dashboard visuals implemented and validated in staging - [x] Alert thresholds tuned and reviewed with SRE - [x] Integration tests for telemetry aggregation added - [x] Docs and runbook updated - [x] CI green and manual validation on canary cluster. Rollout plan: deploy dashboards and telemetry change to staging, enable alerts in staging for 48h, then rollout to prod with 1hr monitoring window and ability to quickly mute via mute endpoints. Backout: revert alerting YAML and dashboard JSON and redeploy. Related: ENG-8421 for long-term adaptive alert framework.

review_comments: Jared Li: Looks good overall; can you explain why we switched evaluation window to 15m?
Michael Chen: 15m reduces noise from short-lived traffic spikes and aligns with P99 sampling; SRE agreed after reviewing historical incidents.
Priya Nair: Please add a short note in the runbook about how to correlate KV metrics with model rollouts.
Michael Chen: Added the runbook note and a sample PromQL snippet for correlating model_version tag.
Luca Moretti: Alert thresholds LGTM but please run canary for 24h before full prod enable; approved after staging run.
release_notes: Refined token-KV cost & latency dashboards; added per-model/token breakdowns; tuned alert thresholds and evaluation windows to reduce false positives; added runbook for investigation; minor telemetry API additions.
notes_for_ops: Monitor P99 token_kv_latency and token_kv_cost for top-10 models after rollout
Mute low-traffic models using label:traffic_tier=low if noise persists
If rollout causes missing metrics, revert pkg/telemetry/aggregation.go to previous aggregation key and redeploy
testing_summary: Verified dashboard panels in staging cluster with 48h traffic
Synthetic load test to validate P99 sensitivity
Integration tests added to guard aggregation regressions
